cohort: Infants in the Growing Up in Singapore Towards healthy Outcomes (GUSTO) birth cohort
finding: The study found no evidence that phototherapy for neonatal hyperbilirubinemia is linked to childhood allergic outcomes like eczema, rhinitis, and wheeze.
mod_finding: Infants born by Caesarean section were more likely to undergo phototherapy compared to those born vaginally (17.5% vs 10.7%, p < 0.01).
